hook: Your plane lands below sea level in the Netherlands.
title: Your plane lands below sea level
description:
Amsterdam's Schiphol airport sits about three metres below sea level. It was built on the bed of a drained lake, and dikes and pumps keep the sea out. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Netherlands #Geography
